name: Covariance Matrix from Scaling and Rotation
aliases: Covariance Matrix Construction from Quaternions and Scales
Covariance matrix from scaling and rotation
definition: Constructs a 3x3 covariance matrix from a scaling vector and a rotation quaternion.
summary: It constructs a 3D Gaussian covariance from rotation and scale, then projects it to 2D to preserve ellipsoidal orientation and aspect ratio, unlike billboarding techniques.
